title: Bessport Mummy Sleeping Bag — Water-Repellent, Blue
short_description: Mummy sleeping bag for one person made of polyester with polyester fill. Water-repellent, with a zipper and foldable – for camping and outdoor use.
long_description: The Bessport sleeping bag has the classic mummy shape and is designed for one person. The outer material and the fill are made of polyester. According to the Amazon listing it is water-repellent, closes with a zipper and can be folded. It is intended for camping, travel and outdoor trips and, according to the listing, can also be used indoors. The variant shown here is the blue version.
features: Outer material and fill made of polyester
buying_angle: Useful for camping and outdoor trips when a foldable, water-repellent mummy sleeping bag for one person is needed.
